name: io.github.minhezluv/google-flow
title: Google Flow
description: Generate images and Veo videos on Google Flow with your Google AI subscription

environmentVariables.name: FLOW_EXPECTED_ACCOUNT
environmentVariables.description: Gmail address that must be signed in to Flow; jobs stop if another account is signed in

environmentVariables.name: FLOW_CDP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Chrome DevTools port of the dedicated browser

environmentVariables.name: FLOW_MCP_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Directory for config, outputs, logs and the job store (default ~/.google-flow-mcp/home)
